news.title: Farcaster acquired by Balaji’s Network School, with new ‘social smart contract’ for users
news.summary: Balaji Srinivasan's Network School acquired Farcaster from Neynar. Users must sign a "social smart contract" or drop to read-only access.

news.title: Google Says It Just Cracked One of Quantum Computing's Biggest Bottlenecks
news.summary: Google's Willow chip cut errors 40x on the scarce “magic states” quantum computers burn through, a step toward smaller, useful machines—and toward ones that could threaten today's encryption.

news.title: Russia Will Soon Ban Peer-to-Peer Bitcoin Trading, Central Bank Confirms
news.summary: Russians have until July 1, 2027 to buy and sell crypto directly with each other. After that, every trade runs through a broker or exchange approved by the Bank of Russia.

news.title: Binance.US seeks $1B valuation in potential $100M funding round: Report
news.summary: The crypto exchange was reportedly looking to use the additional funding to regain market share following Binance’s 2023 settlement with US authorities.

news.title: Buying cripto straight from blue wallet
news.summary:
Im very newbie in bitcoin, i just buy some sats every week for the last year, i buy from binance and send it to a blue wallet when it stacks.

Dont know really too much about safety and privacy, but the latest update on blue wallet app has a button to buy cripto straight from the wallet, it requires an google or apple account to do it, how safe and private is to put an email on a blue wallet ? Should i do it instead from buying from binance ?
